verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is GPU hardware and a server system (DGX/HGX), not a data application with an in-product interface that analyzes a user's data. Built-in AI-generated insights from user data is a category error for this product type. Its role as a platform for running LLMs (NIM, NeMo) is a developer building block, not an in-product insights feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
